faq.heading: FAQ
faq.description: Common questions from colleges, companies, and partners.

items.question: How does HireKarma help colleges improve placement rates?
items.answer: We combine campus placement systems, student readiness tools, and recruiter networks — so TPOs spend less time on logistics and more time on outcomes.

items.question: What products should we start with?
items.answer: Most campuses begin with DISHA for placement operations and SolviqAI for student readiness. Employers often start with Lakshya or Shortlisted, depending on their hiring model.

items.question: Can companies hire from multiple colleges at once?
items.answer: Yes. Our platforms are built for multi-campus coordination with shared visibility for recruiters and institutions.

items.question: Do you work beyond Odisha?
items.answer: We are rooted in Odisha and serve partners across India — campuses, employers, and digital public infrastructure programs.
